## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.8

### 新功能

- **启动时自动请求 Mac 权限**：缺「辅助功能」或「输入监控」时，每次启动（包括登录时静默启动到菜单栏）会弹一次系统授权框，不会反复打扰。「辅助功能」现在直接弹系统授权框，不再只是打开设置页。
- **「重置并重新授权」按钮**：在「设置 › 关于与诊断 › 权限」里。系统设置里的开关开着、黑着跑却仍显示未授权，通常是旧版本（0.1.6 及以前，签名不同）留下的失效条目。点这个按钮会清掉黑着跑的旧授权记录，再重新弹出授权框。旁边还有「重启黑着跑」按钮，给需要重启才生效的权限用。
- **权限状态自动刷新**：设置窗口开着时，每 1.5 秒刷新一次权限状态，在系统设置里授权后不用重启就会变绿。
- **内建屏「检测」**：在「设置 › 息屏 › 内建屏」旁。接着外接屏时，确认后把 MacBook 内建屏断开约 3 秒再接回，结果分三种：
  - 能真正断开（面板断电）；
  - 不支持（Intel、macOS 13 以下等），只能把背光调到 0 并盖黑色遮罩；
  - 断开后没能自动接回（合上再打开盖子，或重启即可恢复）。

  结果连同机型、芯片、系统版本记在配置里，也显示在「关于与诊断」里。

### 对「自动」模式的影响

- 内建屏选「自动」时，在这台 Mac 上测过且成功就会使用断开，**包括以前默认不断开的 M3 系列和 iMac**；测过失败就不再断开；没测过照旧按原来的规则（M3 和 iMac 不断开）。
- 换了机型、芯片或 macOS 大版本后，原来的检测结果不再算数，需要重新检测。
- 手动选「断开」或「只关背光」不受检测结果影响。
- 检测中途如果黑着跑崩溃或被强退，下次打开时会把内建屏接回来。

更新方式：在「设置 › 关于与诊断」里点「更新并重启」，或等每日检查自动提示。

## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.8

### New

- **Asks for Mac permissions at launch**: when Accessibility or Input Monitoring is missing, BlankRun shows the system prompt once per launch, also when it starts quietly in the menu bar at login. Accessibility now gets the real system prompt instead of just opening System Settings.
- **"Reset and ask again"** in Settings › About & Diagnostics › Permissions. If a switch is on in System Settings but BlankRun still says not granted, it's usually a stale entry from an older version with a different signature (0.1.6 and earlier). The button clears BlankRun's old permission entries and asks again. A "Restart BlankRun" button sits next to it for permissions that only take effect after a restart.
- **Live permission status**: while Settings is open, the permission status refreshes every 1.5 seconds, so it turns green without a restart once you allow it.
- **Built-in display "Test"** next to Settings › Screen Off › Built-in display. With an external display connected and after a confirmation, it disconnects the MacBook's built-in display for about 3 seconds and reconnects it. The result is one of:
  - can truly disconnect (panel powered down);
  - not supported (Intel, macOS before 13, …): backlight 0 plus a black overlay only;
  - didn't come back on its own (close and open the lid, or restart).

  The result is saved with the model, chip and macOS version and also shows in About & Diagnostics.

### What it changes for "Automatic"

- With the built-in display set to Automatic, a passed test on this Mac turns disconnecting on, **including M3 Macs and iMacs**, which were skipped by default. A failed test turns it off, and an untested Mac keeps the old rule (no disconnect on M3 and iMac).
- After a change of model, chip or major macOS version the old result no longer counts; test again.
- Choosing Disconnect or Backlight off only by hand is not affected by the test.
- If BlankRun crashes or is force-quit during the test, the built-in display is reconnected the next time it opens.

To update, click "Update and restart" in Settings › About & Diagnostics, or wait for the daily check.
